framework.name: Dioxus
framework.renderer: HTML/CSS through browser or system WebView
framework.dependencyPolicy: Direct dependencies use exact versions; Cargo.lock records the full resolution.
framework.resolvedComponents: The Dioxus 0.7.0 facade resolved compatible 0.7.10 renderer components.

hostTests.detail: 2 targeted tests passed: deterministic semantic HTML and report-schema coverage.

webCompile.detail: Dioxus web binary compiled for wasm32-unknown-unknown.

desktopCompile.detail: Dioxus desktop binary compiled for x86_64-apple-darwin.

iosCompile.detail: aarch64-apple-ios target exists, but objc2-exception-helper could not locate the iphoneos SDK through xcrun.

androidCompile.detail: Dioxus mobile binary compiled for aarch64-linux-android with NDK 27.1 and API 35 linker.

launch.detail: No browser, desktop WebView, simulator, or device renderer was launched.

visual.detail: Deterministic SSR HTML passed, but no screenshot or pixel comparison was captured.

accessibility.detail: SSR contract verifies semantic main, nav, buttons, pressed state, status role, live region, names, and stable focusable order; screen-reader behavior remains unproven.

native.detail: Pilot web, desktop, and mobile surfaces use HTML/CSS DOM or WebView renderers; platform-native widgets and experimental Dioxus Native were not implemented.

packaging.detail: Cargo checks produced no web deployment, macOS bundle, IPA, APK, signing, or store artifact.

decision.reason: Cross-target compile and semantic DOM evidence are promising, but launch, visual behavior, assistive-technology behavior, iOS compilation, native integration, and packaging remain unsupported or unproven.
